svg.text: Oxygen Literature Map: Clinical Oxygen Evidence vs Energy-System Evidence
Draft classification from the DRC3 oxygen literature review table (n=94). Position is keyword/codebook-based, not final systematic-review coding.
Oxygen information: need, modality, access, or clinical oxygen outcomes
Energy information: power source, reliability, backup, cost, or autonomy

svg.text: Use this as a searchlight: papers in the upper-right support DRC3a's claim
that oxygen access is an electricity-conditioned system capability;
lower-right papers support clinical oxygen need but usually under-specify
